en-US.description: Another free PDF document compression software.
en-US.longDescription: Reduce PDF Size is a free PDF document compression software that can quickly compress PDF documents and reduce PDF file size. It supports five different compression settings, allowing you to choose a compression ratio according to your requirements. In addition, this software supports batch conversion, enabling you to compress many PDF files at one time.
en-US.name: Reduce PDF Size
